dimensions.definition_quote: identifies represented, underrepresented, and unassessed populations, sites, devices, and data sources
dimensions.quote: First, a demographics and omission narrative identifies represented, underrepresented, and unassessed populations, sites, devices, and data sources.

dimensions.quote: Second, an error-gap metrics module reports clinically relevant subgroup sensitivity, specificity, calibration, false-positive and false-negative rates, uncertainty intervals, acceptance criteria, and their clinical implications.
